blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Aboitiz Power Corporation (AboitizPower) was among the organizations commended by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) for its exemplary contribution to the region’s energy sector, particularly in its cooperation on nuclear energy technologies, information sharing, and capacity building. Last July, AboitizPower signed a memorandum of understanding with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. in Gyeongju, South Korea, to explore the potential applicability of nuclear energy technologies in the Philippines, including conducting joint pre-feasibility studies.
